title: Algerian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A rich and flavorful Algerian-inspired stir fry made with tender chicken and velvety sauce. Serve with a side of earthy vegetables for a well-rounded meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced carrot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the velvety sauce.
Season with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.
Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
